instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium full shot from a low angle in a gym with white mats and framed posters. In the foreground on the left, the man in the black t-shirt and leggings (R1) performs a low lunge stretch, smiling. Behind him on the right, the man in the black t-shirt and blue shorts (R2) does a split stretch while looking down. Both men stretch side-by-side on the mat under bright, even indoor lighting.
